title: Eren's Better Loots
description: A lightweight mod that lets mobs drop Lootbags containing random items, adding simple and balanced rewards to combat.
body:
Description — v1.0.0

Eren’s Better Loots brings a fun and rewarding twist to Minecraft’s combat system 🎒✨
Hostile mobs now have a chance to drop Lootbags, each containing random items ranging from simple resources to valuable treasures 💎📦

The mod stays fully vanilla-friendly, lightweight, and balanced ⚖️
Every fight becomes a small surprise, making exploration and combat more exciting than ever 🔥🗡️

🌍 Language Support

Eren’s Better Loots includes full language support for:

🇺🇸 English

🇹🇷 Türkçe

🇷🇺 Русский

All item names, lootbag descriptions, and messages are fully localized for each language.
